title: Person
description: An individual in the community. Personal fields never cross to anyone without a matching Consent record.

journey_stage.description: Deliberately free text: every community defines its own stages. Configure them; do not assume them.

channel_identities.description: One user_id, many channels. The profile is not owned by whichever channel was used first.

handle_ref.description: An opaque reference to the channel identity, not the raw phone number or address.

personalization.description: opt_out is honored without argument -- see the privacy-controls skill.
